question: 只看交易所 NSDQ 的 2013 年佣金收入是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(fact_trades.Commission) AS commission_revenue FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID = dim_date.SK_DateID INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_security AS dim_security ON fact_trades.SK_SecurityID = dim_security.SK_SecurityID WHERE dim_date.CalendarYearID = 2013 AND dim_security.ExchangeID = 'NASDAQ' LIMIT 100

fibo_concepts.note: 佣金是经纪服务收取的费用
值域别名载体：NSDQ 是交易所代码 NASDAQ 的旧缩写写法，归一由 semantic/values/ 的 aliases 映射驱动（ADR-0016）
